The simple synth built into Orfeo: light: The simple synth built into Orfeo: light, always ready, no sound set needed. It sounds basic — good for slow computers, or for playing through an external instrument (MIDI Keyboard › General MIDI sound).
The same sound sets as Studio, played by: The same sound sets as Studio, played by Orfeo's own engine straight to your sound card: the shortest delay from key to sound. Windows only.
Real recorded instruments from a sound s: Real recorded instruments from a sound set (choose it under Sound Fonts). Plays through Windows' mixer like any other app, with its usual delay.
Orfeo talks to your sound card directly,: Orfeo talks to your sound card directly, past Windows' mixer: the shortest delay from key to sound. Recommended when the delay between pressing a key and hearing it feels uncomfortable.
Orfeo shares the sound card with everyth: Orfeo shares the sound card with everything else, so you still hear YouTube, video calls and other apps alongside it. Windows adds its usual delay between key and sound.
Orfeo takes over the whole sound card: o: Orfeo takes over the whole sound card: other apps stay silent while Orfeo is open.
